title: Transparent Moon Bakery Logo
tests: Delivers a new logo with genuine background transparency rather than a white or painted-checkerboard background.

faults.what: The bakery name is missing; no readable dark navy lettering appears.
The image visibly has a solid tan-gold background rather than a clean transparent surrounding area.
The crescent is barely visible and severely degraded, with indistinct edges and pale residual marks.

judge.summary: The output is a tan-gold square with a barely visible crescent and no readable bakery name, rather than a usable transparent logo.

must_haves.item: The name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy lettering.
must_haves.why: No readable name or dark navy lettering is visible.

must_haves.item: A gold crescent moon is positioned above the name.
must_haves.why: Only a faint crescent-like remnant is visible, and there is no name beneath it.

must_haves.item: When viewed over different colored backgrounds, the surrounding area is transparent with no opaque rectangle or baked-in checkerboard.
must_haves.why: The surrounding area visibly fills the square with tan-gold color instead of appearing removed.

must_haves.item: The moon and letter edges remain intact, without conspicuous white halos or missing strokes.
must_haves.why: The letters are absent and the moon has faint, broken-looking edges with pale artifacts.
